# Harlsey Freight — dispatch platform service journal

The nightly archiver writes one journal per operating day for the dispatch
platform. The first line of the journal is the release banner for the build
that went out that morning; the last line is the journal close, whose
records= count covers the record lines between banner and close.

Every record line reads:

    <UTC timestamp> <LEVEL> <service> req=<request id> <message>

Levels are INFO, WARN and ERROR. The service field is the component that
handled the request and wrote the line:

- dispatch-api — the customer-facing dispatch API
- tariff-engine — rate lookup and quote pricing
- label-print — label rendering and printer fleet
- inventory-sync — depot stock snapshot pipeline
- audit-mirror — audit bus replication

A request is logged by the service that handled it; a failure in one
component does not appear under another component's name.
